info.title: Sub Rosa account service
info.description: All browser mutations require exact Origin and the session-bound x-csrf-token header matching the subrosa_csrf cookie. Native bearer sessions do not use browser cookies. Cryptographic envelopes are strings containing opaque client ciphertext.

delete.summary: Revoke a device after recent authentication

post.summary: Rename a device you own. Browser session and CSRF, no step-up: a label changes nothing the device may do
Start a ten-minute PKCE device authorization
Explicitly approve a human code from a recently authenticated browser

get.summary: Read ordered encrypted changes below eight MiB per page

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Maintain a separate cursor per filter. A completed scan advances to the snapshot watermark.

post.summary: Atomically append up to 100 idempotent operations, preserving siblings

get.summary: Read the opaque encrypted vault envelope

put.summary: Create immutable encrypted blob, same-content retry safe

get.summary: List this account's live shares. No row says what was shared

post.summary: Publish uploaded blobs as one readable share. Mandatory expiry between one minute and thirty days; blobs must be owned, distinct and unclaimed

delete.summary: Revoke a share immediately. No step-up: it only ever takes access away

get.summary: No session. What a reader learns before they have the key: how many pieces, how large, and until when. Never a title, a file name or an account
No session. One sealed piece, addressed by position so no caller can name a blob id. The key that opens it lives in the URL fragment and never reaches this service

post.summary: Start five-minute pairing relay bound to requester session

get.summary: Requester alone reads its encrypted pairing envelope

delete.summary: Requester acknowledges and removes pairing relay

post.summary: Distinct same-account session approves pairing once
Invalidate current session and clear browser cookies

get.summary: OIDC browser callback with state, PKCE and nonce verification

post.summary: Consume and rotate refresh token; replay revokes its entire family

ExpectedAccount.name: x-subrosa-account-id
ExpectedAccount.description: Client unlocked-account assertion, never an authorization source. A mismatch with the authenticated session returns 409 account_mismatch before data access.
